description:
Full metadata and risk profile for one crypto asset on the Mangrove platform: approval status, risk score breakdown, regulatory status and identifiers. Use it when the user asks about a specific asset's approval or risk detail rather than a live price.

[Access: pay 0.001 USDC via x402 (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header) OR authenticate with an API key. An x402-capable client will auto-pay; API-key clients pay nothing per call.]

symbol.description: Asset symbol, e.g. BTC or ETH.

name: get_asset
